sources.snippet: zeromodels/regnet-x-080 Paper: Designing Network Design Spaces (arXiv:2003.13678) · HF Papers RegNet is a family of ConvNets whose per-stage widths and depths follow a simple quantized-linear rule. This is the X variant: a 3x3 stride-2 stem then four stages of 1x1 -> 3x3 grouped -> [SE] -> 1x1 residual blocks.
